rationale: Raw schedule table 5 confirms both flagged identifiers are individual investment rows, not subtotals: row 23 names Common membership Interests and supplies 800 shares, and row 24 names Preferred membership Interests and supplies shares, amortized cost, fair value, and net-assets percentage.
